market.what: Co polishing of recycled battery-grade NiSO4 to <=50 ppm Co (extra SX scrub stages or IX resins), world
market.method: est.: ~120 kt recycled Ni x ~$80/t Ni polishing cost

value.logic: halve polishing cost ($5M) + avoid off-spec NiSO4 discount (2% of ~$1.9B NiSO4 x 5% = $2M)
value.revenue_logic: $7M x 2.66 (2032) x 10% adoption x 40% capture; primary MHP-to-NiSO4 polishing (~8x larger) is upside outside recycling

trend.drivers: recycled Ni sulfate grows with black mass; recycled Ni ~10% of China NiSO4 feed (2026)

indirect_startups: Ascend Elements (makes mixed pCAM, no pure NiSO4 needed)
competition.notes: weak pain: Co is a cathode metal, so trace Co matters only when NiSO4 is sold to spec; existing resins work

lab.synth: grafted resin: 1-2 step Co ligand on resin (3 variants)
lab.test: breakthrough on 100+ g/L NiSO4 spiked to 0.1-1 g/L Co, ppm Co by ICP-MS/OES, Ni loss; university lab
lab.logic: ligand+grafting 10 wk $30k; columns 6 wk + ~250 ICP x $50 = $20k

sale.gates: drop-in column test on plant NiSO4 3-6 mo; 6-12 mo plant trial; NiSO4 spec sign-off
